texts.title:
Disposable household income of the lowest decile in the income
distribution, 2003
texts.source:
Source: Incomes across the Distribution Database (Nolan, Thewissen, Roser) in levels (2016)
Note: Disposable household income is the sum of a household’s employment and self-employment income, capital income, social security and
private transfers minus income taxes and social security contributions. It is adjusted for the household size (square root of the household size). It
is adjusted for inflation and for price differences between countries and expressed in 2011 international dollars.
